content: We evaluated MT models using case-sensitive and tokenized BLEU BIBREF23 on test sets, using Moses's multi-bleu.perl. Statistical significance ( INLINEFORM0 ) on the difference of BLEU scores was tested by Moses's bootstrap-hypothesis-difference-significance.pl.
